title: I cannot for the life of me get walking frames. What am I doing wrong?
author: Typical_Bowler_3557
selftext:
Please forgive me. I am AI illiterate. I guess. I am trying to create a jrpg in Rosebud, but I've tried a bunch of others.

All I need to do is get walking sprites. Like 32 but era ish. Every program I try; Chatgpt, claude, I don't even know I've tried over a dozen apps and websites and they all blur together. Characters walking to the east or west just get the same leg forward. I cannot get a believable animation; Just four frames walking east, in a believable stride.

I am at my wits end. Has anyone got a way I can do this? I don't understand what I am doing wrong. Any insight or smark remarks would be appreciated
